record.field: Risk analysis and information system security policies
Documented risk analysis policy and information system security policies, reviewed periodically.
Prevent, detect, analyse, contain, respond and recover from incidents.
Backups, disaster recovery, backup management and crisis management.
Security of the supply chain including direct suppliers and service providers.
Security in acquisition, development and maintenance, including vulnerability handling and disclosure.
Policies and procedures to assess the effectiveness of cybersecurity risk-management measures.
Basic cyber hygiene practices and cybersecurity training.
Policies on the use of cryptography and encryption where appropriate.
HR security, access control and asset management
Human resources security, access control policies and asset management.
MFA or continuous authentication, secured voice/video/text communications and emergency systems where appropriate.
